quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: When will you realize? The more you take, the less you have.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: There's no charge for awesomeness... or attractiveness.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: My fist hungers for justice! That was my... fist.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: I'm not a big fat panda. I'm THE big fat panda.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: You have to let go of who you were, and embrace who you are.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: Now, who wants to do the right thing for the wrong reasons?
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: I've been asking myself that question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? I'm all of those things. I am the Dragon Warrior!
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Your mind is like this water, my friend. When it is agitated, it becomes difficult to see. But if you allow it to settle, the answer becomes clear.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
